notes: Sources: brochure woodgrove-acres-3.pdf (site plan p9, unit distribution p10-11, floor plans p12-21); board.pdf column col2 (Woodgrove image xref 3348 placed at row2 [459.1,276.2,592.3,372.1], row3 [442.9,481.9,578.1,577.3], row5 [366.2,718.9,486.2,803.5] board pt). Board vector annotations were mapped onto the brochure site plan with that affine transform; overlays: ov3_all.png, wa_<block>_opp.png, ov2.png, ov5.png.

Rental excluded: Block 448A (full rental block, 180 units, 12 stacks) and rental stacks 446A #669/#671, 446B #683, 447A #697/#699 (marked RENTAL, NOT AVAILABLE FOR SALE). Counted sale units 656 = brochure 656; per type and per block counts match the site plan table exactly.

447A #701/#703 start at storey 3, 446B #673-#681 and #695 start at storey 3 (#683 rental from 4), 447B #727 starts at storey 3, 447B #729-#741 stop at storey 15 (blocks 18/15 storeys). Unit distribution read by sampling cell colours (ud2.py) and checked visually; a red FUTURE AMENITIES label at 447A #01 was not a unit.

Facing: board row5 arrows (colour NW magenta, SE purple, NE blue), one arrow within 16 pt of each sale stack; all agree with the row3 semicircle orientation (plan blocks run at bearing 65/245 deg, so long facades face NNW/SSE = NW/SE; the 447B east wing faces ENE = NE). No SW units.

gt30m: each board row3 annotation is a group (opacity 0.53) of a faint full circle plus a semicircle, both one colour, labelled 15m by the user (measured radius 25.2 PDF pt = 13.9 m, diameter 27.7 m: two facing 15 m semicircles meet at about 30 m). The semicircle straight edge midpoint lies on the unit; 61 semicircles mapped to 58 stacks (447B #731 has two). Pass 1 = vector fill colour of the unit's own semicircle; pass 2 = pixel colour of the part of that semicircle not overlapped by any other semicircle on a fresh 900 dpi render (pass2b.py, board_row3_col2_900dpi.png). Passes agree for all 41 sale stacks. Neighbours' overlapping semicircles were not counted (per brief). centre_px is in the full board page rendered at 900 dpi; per-stack crops are in crops/.

Facilities: board row2 has 16 distinct 30 m circles (radius 54.3 pt = 29.9 m) on legend markers 1 Children's playground (x3), 2 Adult fitness station (x2), 3 Elderly fitness station (x3, one on the MSCP roof garden), 4 Precinct pavilion (x2), 5 Drop-off porch (x3), 6 Space reserved for future community use -> Community space (MSCP roof), 7 Preschool at 1st storey (MSCP block 447) -> Preschool, 8 Future amenities/facilities at 1st storey of 447A with inaccessible green roof. One duplicate circle and one circle outside the site plan frame (below the plan, no number) were ignored. A stack is near when the circle reaches its unit footprint, approximated as a 5 m disc around the unit centre; borderline cases (within 5 m) are listed in each stack note. facilities_has: only 447A (Future amenities/facilities at its 1st storey, matching facilities_1st_storey.json); block 446 and 448 are separate pavilion/drop-off structures and 447 is the MSCP, not residential blocks.

position: Corner = end unit of its corridor/wing on the typical floor plan (446A 653/655/663/665, 446B 675/677/691/693, 447A 703/705/713/715, 447B 721/723/737/739); judgement, medium certainty for units at a lobby stub.

chute_m: from the main entrance door centre (detected from the paired door+gate swing arcs, doors3.py, fp<page>_dx.png) to the centre of the CENTRALISED REFUSE CHUTE box on the typical plan (446A p13, 446B p16, 447A p18, 447B p20), 8.016 pt/m. Each block has a single chute room (centralised + recyclable chute about 3.5 m apart), so far-end units are 45 to 59 m away.

roof_floors: no residential floor plan shows an accessible roof garden; ROOF AT 2ND/3RD STOREY ONLY are plain roofs over voids, 447A has a GREEN ROOF (INACCESSIBLE), 447B 16th to 18th shows ROOF (INACCESSIBLE). The accessible roof garden is on the MSCP (block 447) and is not reached from any flat, so roof_floors is [] for all stacks.

wind_open: north is page up (north arrow on p9). From each unit centre, a 30 m wedge at bearing 90 to 135 was tested against other residential blocks (their unit centres buffered by 5 m, including rental block 448A) and the off-site public housing blocks 450A/450B/452A (U/C) outlines traced from the site plan (east_grid.png). Blocked: 446A 651/653/663, 446B 691, 447A 715, 447B 735/737. Borderline cases are noted per stack.

mscp_m: unit centre to nearest edge of the MSCP outline (mscp_distance.json _geometry), rounded to 5 m; mscp_m_exact also given. Values differ from mscp_distance.json block-centre figures by more than 10 m for end stacks because they are per stack (e.g. 446A ranges 100 to 140 vs block 120; 446B 50 to 105 vs 80; 447B 35 to 75 vs 50).
mrt_m is null: no MRT station is on the site plan.
Independent review 2026-10-13: units 656/656, facing/gt30m 41/41 agree; position x8, wind x5 fixed; facilities and car park block-wide (user rule).
